project.name: cpd
project.summary: cpd turns one ticket into a reviewed pull request. A lead AI agent breaks the work into small jobs, a team of worker agents does them side by side, and cpd checks each step, merges the results and opens the pull request on GitHub. One program, cpd, holds the commands, the background engine and the shared rules; an add-on runs inside the pi agent, and a web and desktop app lets people watch and steer it.

nodes.label: Commands
nodes.summary: The cpd program people and agents type commands into: it reads each command and hands it to the shared rules or the engine.

nodes.label: Background engine
nodes.summary: Runs on every machine all the time, waking up every few seconds to start ready jobs, watch pull requests, raise alerts and keep agents alive.

nodes.label: Heartbeat
nodes.summary: The repeating loop itself: when it wakes, what it runs each time, sleeping, restarting and making sure only one copy runs.

nodes.label: Pull request watcher
nodes.summary: Opens pull requests when a piece of work is done, notices when they close or get stuck, and keeps outside data fresh.

nodes.label: Inbox and alerts
nodes.summary: Turns things that need a person (questions, failures, refusals, machine problems) into inbox items and alerts.

nodes.label: Agent upkeep
nodes.summary: Starts and stops worker agents, archives finished ones, tidies up, holds back when a model provider is down, and runs the knowledge tidier.

nodes.label: Live feed
nodes.summary: Streams every change as it happens to the web app over a local connection.

nodes.label: Machine check
nodes.summary: Checks that this computer has everything cpd needs and reports what is missing.

nodes.label: Shared rules
nodes.summary: Everything cpd knows how to do, used by both the commands and the engine: plans, jobs, agent sessions, pull requests, the inbox and the saved records.

nodes.label: Saved records
nodes.summary: The database on each machine that keeps every plan, job, session and event, and the step-by-step history of how its layout changed.

nodes.label: Shared knowledge
nodes.summary: Keeps the decisions and notes that several plans share, lets agents search them, and proposes tidying old ones for a person to approve.

nodes.label: Plans and jobs

nodes.label: Plans

nodes.label: Worker attempts

nodes.label: Pull requests and merging

nodes.label: Branches and merging

flows.title: A ticket becomes a pull request
flows.description: How one piece of work travels from the lead agent's plan to a pull request on GitHub.

steps.note: The lead agent, inside pi, writes the plan and its jobs by running cpd commands.
cpd reads each command and hands it to the shared rules.
The plan, its parts and its jobs are checked and saved.
Everything is written to the machine's database.
On its next heartbeat the engine sees jobs that are ready to start.
It opens a fresh worker agent for each job, in its own copy of the code.
When a worker hands in its result, cpd merges it, runs the quality check and opens the pull request.
The pull request appears on GitHub, ready for review.

flows.title: Watching work live in the app
flows.description: How a change in cpd shows up on someone's screen.

steps.note: Something happens, such as a job finishing, and cpd records an event.
The engine's live feed sends the new event out straight away.
The app's local server receives it and works out what changed on screen.
The plan board and inbox update in the browser.
